nodes.text:
You're upright and you're armed. I have a list, and everyone on it is neither.

I don't send people to die. I send them to fetch, and if fetching turns into dying that's the marsh's doing, not mine.

choices.label: Who put you in charge of a list?

nodes.text: Nobody. That's rather the point - there's no one left to. I started writing things down so we'd know what we'd lost, and it turned into a list of things someone might go and get back.

Warlord Hesk's outfit. Halberdiers, outriders, a captain who was a decent man before the pay stopped. They hold the causeway and tax anyone crossing it.

They're not monsters. That's what makes them a problem - a monster you can simply kill.
